verdict.rationale: Bitbucket is a SaaS code-hosting platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe finds an official Atlassian MCP server documented at github.com/atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server, so a vendor-official server exists. However, the evidence never shows that this server exposes Bitbucket repos, PRs or pipelines rather than only other Atlassian products. Missing for 10: confirmation that the server covers Bitbucket, a documented tool list and setup/auth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
